title: Nutrition — four tubes, four materials
question: The tubes stay at the centre; what they are made of changes. Pick one to build, or steer.

options.label: Laboratory glass
options.thesis: Real clear test tubes, coloured liquid to its level with a meniscus, on a pale ground.
options.viewport: Four upright test tubes, percentage above, value below.
options.risk: The most literal: reads 'lab' as much as 'food'.

options.label: Frosted glass
options.thesis: Frosted capsules on a soft lavender-peach ground, each glowing gently with its colour.
options.viewport: A frosted card, four capsules with scale ticks.
options.risk: Needs a background behind it to read as glass.

options.label: Soft relief
options.thesis: Channels pressed into a soft white surface, a raised rounded fill rising in each.
options.viewport: A soft card, four channels like sliders.
options.risk: The quietest; the colour does all the work.

options.label: Living liquid
options.thesis: A wavy liquid surface and tiny rising bubbles, bold colour, a crisp white card.
options.viewport: Four slim tubes with coloured percentages above.
options.risk: The loudest and most playful; motion (the wave, the bubbles) would carry it.
